content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are services that allow you to receive payments without the need for extensive identity verification. This is particularly relevant for digital creators in regions where traditional payment processors impose stringent regulations or are simply unavailable. By leveraging these gateways, creators can sell products like ebooks, courses, and templates directly to consumers, ensuring that they retain a higher percentage of their earnings. For example, using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad can save you substantial amounts in fees, allowing you to reinvest in your content or grow your business. Understanding this infrastructure is vital for creators looking to optimize their financial transactions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind no-KYC payment gateways typically involves a combination of decentralized technologies that enhance security and reduce costs. For instance, when a customer makes a purchase, the transaction is processed on-chain, ensuring transparency and immutability. In this setup, you can integrate platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend handling, which facilitate automated delivery of your digital products. This seamless integration allows for instant product delivery upon payment confirmation, enhancing customer satisfaction. Furthermore, utilizing services like Supabase for order management ensures that your data remains secure and accessible, empowering you to operate independently of traditional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are looking to maintain full control over their sales process. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, software, or other digital products, this model empowers you to bypass conventional payment restrictions that often limit your reach and profitability. It's particularly beneficial for creators in regions with unstable currencies or heavy financial scrutiny, as it provides an alternative payment method that is both reliable and low-cost. By embracing this architecture, you position yourself to not only expand your market but also to maximize your earnings by minimizing fees.
NOWPayments offers a mere 0.5% fee, in stark contrast to Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this digital commerce architecture include a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, a reliable hosting service like Cloudflare Pages, and a robust backend system powered by tools such as Google Apps Script or Supabase. Each element functions cohesively to create a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer. The payment gateway facilitates immediate on-chain transactions, while the hosting service ensures that your products are quickly accessible after purchase. Meanwhile, the backend system manages orders and customer data, giving you full ownership of your sales process. This combination not only enhances operational efficiency but also fortifies your sovereignty as a digital creator.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this system, start by selecting your product offerings and determining how you will host your digital files. Use Cloudflare Pages for free hosting, ensuring your site is optimized for fast delivery. Next, set up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate the payment verification process using NOWPayments. After confirming the payment, ensure that your digital goods are automatically delivered through a service like Google Drive. Lastly, revisit your sales strategy to maximize your reach by advertising your new, low-fee payment options. This streamlined approach enables you to launch your digital storefront quickly and efficiently, without reliance on traditional payment processors.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is feasible by using no-KYC payment gateways like NOWPayments. These services allow you to receive payments directly in cryptocurrencies, which can be converted at the time of the transaction. This not only circumvents high fees but also provides you with the freedom and control over your sales process.
Full ownership of your data is possible with no reliance on third-party platforms.

This kit includes all the blueprints and templates necessary to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. You can find it at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook online using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments. This service allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing traditional payment processors.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way to sell digital downloads without incurring platform fees is to set up your own infrastructure using services like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to retain most of your earnings.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by utilizing no-KYC payment gateways and a self-hosted website. This approach eliminates reliance on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the benefits of using a no-KYC payment gateway?
The benefits include lower transaction fees, immediate payment processing, and full control over your sales data. This empowers creators to retain more revenue.
How do I automate product delivery after a sale?
You can automate product delivery by setting up Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to trigger the delivery of your digital products once payment is confirmed.
